parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name for which you want to change the acceleration region. You can specify only one domain name.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description:
The information about the acceleration region. {"coverage":"overseas"}

Valid values for coverage:

*   **domestic**: Chinese mainland
*   **overseas**: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)
*   **global**: global

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn modify-cdn-domain-schdm-by-property --domain-name example.com --property coverage_:_overseas --region cn-hangzhou
